entities.name: Matías Tudela
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Matías Tudela is a Spanish rugby union player. He represents Spain in rugby sevens and is their current captain. He was part of the team that defeated Samoa to earn the last spot for the 2016 Summer Olympics. Tudela is a member of Spain's national rugby sevens team for the 2016 Summer Olympics.
